text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the river, Air Shakur began to 
talk about "theoretical numerical limits."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A river has a threshold. If it tries to 
swallow more water than that, it 
overflows. Or the river itself breaks...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for Umamusume. This year, 
many Umamusume will have to challenge the 
absolute limits of their abilities.
